title: Hong Kong Daily Press 1876-03-31
summary: DESERTION. A YOUTHFUL REPROBATE. STEALING BRASS FROM BOATS. ALLEGED LARCENY OF MONEY. UNLAWFUL POSSESSION. SELLING SPIRITS WITHOUT A LICENSE. DISEASED MEAT. ALLEGED KIDNAPPING.
